item.title: Tina Knowles Reveals She ‘Got Really Emotional’ Seeing Beyoncé & Blue Ivy at the 2026 Met Gala
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we're dishing out the latest in entertainment news. Yesterday, the Met Gala took the world by storm, and for one proud mom, it was a night to remember.
[Tina Knowles interview clip plays]
Host: Tina Knowles, mom of Beyoncé and Solange, appeared on the Today show to talk about her new memoir, but the conversation quickly turned to the Met Gala. Knowles got emotional when talking about seeing her daughter Beyoncé and granddaughter Blue Ivy walk the red carpet.
Tina Knowles: "I got really emotional, shed a few tears... Seeing [Blue Ivy] out there looking confident and beautiful brought tears to my eyes."
Host: That moment was especially poignant for Knowles, as it reminded her of Beyoncé's first red carpet appearance when she was just 15. Knowles called it "déjà vu," referencing one of Beyoncé's hit songs.
Host: This year's Met Gala was a big deal for Beyoncé, as it was her first time attending in 10 years. And this time, she wasn't just a guest - she was a co-chair, alongside Nicole Kidman, Venus Williams, and Anna Wintour.
[Short music transition]
Host: Beyoncé made it a family affair, bringing her husband Jay Z and eldest daughter Blue Ivy along. Notably, Blue Ivy was likely the youngest person in attendance, as the Met Gala has an 18+ rule. It seems an exception was made for the children of co-chairs.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast. We'll be back with more entertainment news and updates. [Outro music continues to play]
